profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Co-Founder with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Polyglot programmer. Skilled in software development lifecycle. Strong business knowledge. Holds a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science and Engineering from UC Berkeley.

positions.title: Senior Web Engineer
positions.description: Created development infrastructure and maintained operations of the public website. Created optimized workflows for development of the site from engineers and non engineers. Dockerized stack to facilitate cross platform development and deployment.

positions.title: Co Founder
positions.description: Led team that created a point of sale system for restaurants which allowed customer input and payment through their own mobile devices. Implemented the entire tech stack. Set up AWS for the production, sandbox, and development environments. Used Swift and React for front ends. Created seamless payment processing workflows for both the restaurant and the consumer. Helped with marketing campaigns.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on the disputes team and as an operations support engineer. Helped migrate the disputes platform out of the app monolith into its own independently scaleable microservice. Embraced test driven development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Implement information systems by designing, developing, and installing software solutions to the existing Java servers. Create new services in a variety of languages to meet the vast needs of the company.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Strategic design and development of an existing Testing Framework in Python (Django).

Designed and wrote a testing framework from the bottom up in Java to fit the changing needs of Dotomi. This framework has been adopted by the entire QA team and has reduced the time it takes to run a comprehensive regression suite from more than 30 minutes to less than 1 minute.

Additionally, responsible for maintenance of Linux servers, java apps, and internal webpages.
